author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: User-style figure (round head, round-shouldered body with a leg split) holding the crook of a tall cane at the left, like the reference. The current drawing was a thin stick figure whose arm and cane merged into one hooked line, reading as a waving figure instead of a person leaning on a cane.
omissions: The arm is a single stroke instead of the reference's outlined sleeve; the cane crook opens outward so it keeps 8 from the body.
